summary.zh: 配置 Nx 单仓并优化构建缓存与依赖边界
summary.en: Set up Nx monorepos with caching and boundaries

description.zh: 覆盖 Nx 工作区搭建、项目边界约束、构建缓存和 affected 命令的使用。适合在大型多包仓库中缩短构建时间并约束依赖方向。需要 Node 环境与已有或新建的 Nx 工作区。
description.en: Configure Nx workspaces, project boundaries, build caching, and affected commands to keep large multi-package repos fast and dependency-clean. Requires Node and an existing or new workspace.
